title: Attribute descriptor alias reads to generated memory calls
changes: Add a scoped test-only native runtime API override and count the selected descriptor row reads through generated-code memory callbacks, including interpreter nesting and packed-owner bytes.
validation: Windows GNU build 60m29opn and Wine 1gs1xgeu passed: five direct generated memory API requests supplied five typed owner bytes and none was nested in interp_one; the altered-row raw/managed state, clock, video, OAM and five nonempty audio streams matched for 240 frames.
The unwrapped 240-frame regression 0zpte7lm passed. Both Wine units protected inputs, removed scratch and drained Wine.
limitations: Attribution covers the five requests on one recorded EUR/Wine route; it does not identify the exact guest instruction PCs, establish other consumers or ordinary batch-wrapper reachability, or validate other platforms. The API override is compiled only for tests.
